# awscc_cloudformation_change_set (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::CloudFormation::ChangeSet



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (List of String) The capabilities that are allowed in the stack.
- `change_set_id` (String) The ARN of the change set.
- `change_set_name` (String) The name of the change set. Must be unique among all change sets associated with the specified stack.
- `change_set_type` (String) The type of change set operation.
- `creation_time` (String) The time the change set was created.
- `deployment_mode` (String) Determines how CloudFormation handles configuration drift during deployment.
- `description` (String) A description to help you identify this change set.
- `import_existing_resources` (Boolean) Indicates if the change set imports resources that already exist.
- `include_nested_stacks` (Boolean) Creates a change set for all nested stacks specified in the template.
- `notification_ar_ns` (List of String) The ARNs of Amazon SNS topics that CloudFormation associates with the stack.
- `on_stack_failure` (String) Determines what action will be taken if stack creation fails.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of an IAM role that CloudFormation assumes when executing the change set.
- `stack_id` (String) The unique ID of the stack.
- `stack_name` (String) The name or unique ID of the stack for which you are creating a change set.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Key-value pairs to associate with the change set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `template_body` (String) A structure that contains the body of the revised template.
- `template_url` (String) The URL of the file that contains the revised template.
- `use_previous_template` (Boolean) Whether to reuse the template associated with the stack to create the change set.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
